description: 视频理解任务的量化挑战，包括时序一致性、内存爆炸、变长序列等问题

input_examples.text_prompt: Describe what happens in this video in detail.
Identify all actions performed in this video.

expected_outputs.response: The video shows a person walking through a park on a sunny day. They pass by several trees and a small pond where ducks are swimming. The person stops briefly to watch the ducks before continuing their walk along the path.
The video contains the following actions: 1) A person enters from the left, 2) They pick up a book from the table, 3) They sit on the chair and start reading, 4) They stand up and exit to the right.

quantization_challenges.description: 视频帧之间存在时序相关性，独立量化每帧会导致时序特征不一致
quantization_challenges.solution: 联合量化所有帧，保持时序一致性

quantization_challenges.description: 视频推理的内存消耗 = 单帧内存 × 帧数，线性增长
quantization_challenges.impact: 16帧 480p 视频需 3.3 GB 内存
quantization_challenges.solution: 限制帧数（移动端 ≤8 帧），使用 KV8

quantization_challenges.description: 视频帧数不固定（8-2048 帧），量化参数需适应不同序列长度
quantization_challenges.impact: 标定用固定长度，部署时遇到更长序列精度下降
quantization_challenges.solution: 动态范围标定 + 分段统计

quantization_challenges.description: 视频理解需要处理长序列（40K-100K tokens），KV Cache 成为内存瓶颈
quantization_challenges.impact: 16帧视频 KV Cache 需 3.9 GB
quantization_challenges.solution: KV8 量化，减少 50% 内存

requirements_for_qualcomm: 视频 3D 卷积 INT8 量化支持
多帧批处理并行化（8-16 帧）
动态 shape 编译（变长 batch/seq_len）
